description: Get current optional seat maps for the exact handoff_id and quote_id returned by prepare_flight_booking. Only approved personal supplier test accounts are currently supported. Before recommending a seat, call get_traveler_context for stated/learned preferences and get_past_trips for historical seat evidence. Explicit preferences take precedence; do not invent a preference from weak or missing history. Do not infer window or aisle from arbitrary seat letters; use current supplier map topology and disclosures. Return the actual seat price, restrictions and passenger/segment scope. Availability is not a reservation. Pass a chosen selection_token unchanged to select_flight_seats, then provide the resulting Gondola checkout link for final Card price and explicit purchase approval.

quote_id.description: Exact current quote UUID for this handoff.

test.description: Use supplier test inventory; approved self-account OAuth only. Listed accounts default to test mode.

name: get_flight_seats
